Account enumeration and security-question disclosure via query parameter
Unauthenticated write gap: empty POST creates records with null ownership binding while the parallel GET is gated
Method-specific mass-assignment: unauthenticated PUT persists product field modification while POST/DELETE are blocked
CAPTCHA cleartext answer leak: server-computed answer served unauthenticated
Exposed observability telemetry: /metrics serves Prometheus-format metrics including LLM token gauges unauthenticated
